meta.name: evaluate
meta.description: Evaluate an AI workflow against representative cases and its permitted actions. Use for model, retrieval or agent evaluation; tests do not grant release authority.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代表性案例检验 AI 工作流,提前看清模型、检索与智能体到底靠不靠谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿不准 AI 模型或智能体上线后的实际效果
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're unsure how well your AI model or agent actually performs

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会读取任务上下文契约与方法文档，用代表性案例和允许的动作评估 AI 工作流（模型、检索或 agent），并如实报告未运行的检查；测试本身不代表发布授权。
howto.when: 当你要求评估模型、检索或 agent 工作流时触发；若由 @fde 调用，则复用其当前脱敏包与范围，不重启设置或重问已有问题。

say.text: 按代表性案例评估这个 agent 工作流
say.note: 产出评估结果，不代表发布授权

say.text: 评估这套检索流程，列出没跑成的检查
用当前脱敏包和范围继续评估
say.note: 由 @fde 调用时复用，不重复提问

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the task context contract and the eval method, then evaluates an AI workflow against representative cases and its permitted actions, reporting any unrun or missing checks. Tests do not grant release authority.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for evaluation of a model, retrieval or agent workflow; when called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Evaluate this agent workflow against representative cases
say_en.note: Reports results; not a release approval

say_en.text: Evaluate this retrieval pipeline and list checks that were not run
Continue the evaluation with the current sanitized packet and scope
